telos.statement: Improve the free-to-paid commercial architecture of the organizational diagnostic product without weakening epistemic integrity.
telos.success_condition: Choose the smallest testable change most likely to increase qualified continuation and willingness-to-pay, and specify the cheapest field evidence that could reverse that choice.

current_state.summary: The public-evidence diagnostic engine is strong (~8.6/10 on the Amarel case) but the client-facing artifact is weaker as a conversion product (~6.5/10). The free output often already gives finding, mechanism, importance, falsifier, owners and next action, so a recipient can act internally without paying. Current candidate architecture is: INTERNAL_FULL_DIAGNOSIS -> free CLIENT_PREVIEW/proof-of-sight -> paid VALIDATED_DIAGNOSIS/decision resolution -> optional intervention. The core engine already separates public evidence from internal uncertainty and can stop at EVIDENCE_CEILING. No field evidence yet establishes which commercial bottleneck dominates.
known_constraints: Do not use artificial scarcity, hide earned public reasoning manipulatively, or weaken caveats to improve conversion.
Do not modify the core diagnostic engine unless commercial evidence requires it.
Do not assume reveal boundary is causal; compare it against novelty, economic materiality, recipient/distribution, urgency and low willingness-to-pay for diagnosis itself.
Prefer a reversible document/message field test to building a portal, dashboard, scoring system or new agent.
Measure qualified continuation, internal evidence sharing, price inquiry and payment; raw reply rate is insufficient.
Outside-in output is a hypothesis/opportunity until internal evidence validates a bottleneck.
Same-model or local-model agreement is discovery only, not independent confirmation.

decision_blocked.statement: What is the smallest commercial-product change worth testing now to close the gap between strong diagnostic quality and weak free-to-paid conversion?
decision_blocked.current_default: Keep the diagnostic engine frozen; separate internal full diagnosis from client preview and test preview/paid-continuation variants in real outbound.
decision_blocked.reversal_condition: Change this default if another bottleneck—novelty, economic materiality, recipient/distribution, urgency, or low willingness-to-pay for diagnosis—dominates reveal design.

signals: REVEAL_GAP: free artifact currently exposes enough mechanism/recommendation to enable internal self-resolution.

NOVELTY_GAP: public novelty does not prove novelty to the internal owner.
CTA_GAP: 'want the full report?' is weaker than a bounded validation job with a defined decision output.

AMAREL: public evidence supports a non-obvious HOWIX/field-execution hypothesis, but cannot tell whether the loop already exists, is legally feasible, is the bottleneck, or what impact it has; those are possible paid-resolution objects.
CANDIDATE_A: free signal -> paid validated diagnosis -> intervention.
CANDIDATE_B: free proof-of-sight + 2-3 competing internal mechanisms -> paid falsification/resolution.
CANDIDATE_C: free finding + evidence ceiling + decision question -> paid internal evidence contract and go/no-go memo.
STRONG_ALT_1: buyers may not pay for diagnosis alone regardless of reveal design.
STRONG_ALT_2: recipient/distribution may dominate artifact design.
STRONG_ALT_3: credible cost-of-status-quo may need to precede any paid ask.

CHEAP_TEST: freeze engine and recipient criteria; across 12-20 matched companies randomize 2-3 preview/paid-job variants; code failure reason and compare qualified continuation, evidence sharing, price inquiry and payment.
ANTI_BUILD: first earn a commercial decision delta in the field.
